tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Of the total amount made available for each fiscal year to carry out this part, the Secretary shall use not less than 2 percent to provide grants under this section, on a competitive basis, to—

children.text: units of local government (including Indian tribes) that are not eligible entities; and
consortia of units of local government described in paragraph (1).

tree.heading: Applications
tree.text: To be eligible to receive a grant under this section, a unit of local government or consortia shall submit to the Secretary an application at such time, in such manner, and containing such information as the Secretary may require, including a plan of the unit of local government to carry out an activity described in section 17154 of this title.

tree.heading: Priority
tree.text: In providing grants under this section, the Secretary shall give priority to units of local government—

children.text: located in States with populations of less than 2,000,000; or
that plan to carry out projects that would result in significant energy efficiency improvements or reductions in fossil fuel use.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective on the date that is 1 day after Dec. 19, 2007, see section 1601 of Pub. L. 110–140, set out as a note under section 1824 of Title 2, The Congress.
